title_o: Order of difficulty of suggestions during hypnosis

replications.journal: International Journal of Clinical and Experimental Hypnosis
replications.quote: In a replication and extension of Field, Evans, and Orne's (1965) research, no support was found for the hypothesis that suggestion order is related to hypnotic responding. Confirming earlier findings, Ss were no more responsive to suggestions ordered from easy-to-difficult than they were to suggestions ordered from difficult-to-easy.
